nextStoryContext: US-001 threaded -L cam through session.ts; US-002 threaded it through src/commands/run.ts. Next stories (US-003 through US-008) thread it through the remaining call sites: src/commands/claude.ts (US-003), src/retry/tmux.ts (US-004), src/commands/retry-monitor.ts (US-005), etc. Pattern is the same: wrap all direct tmux spawn calls with tmuxArgs([...]). Respawn-pane calls after tmuxArgs() have subcommand at args[2]; update test finders from args[0] to args[2] accordingly. Shell-evaluated strings (like the kill-session chain in agentCmd) must use the literal 'tmux -L cam' since tmuxArgs() only applies to direct spawn calls.
